title: Pénteken, szombaton, vasárnap — finishing the week

sections.content: The same -n pattern you learned for hétfő–csütörtök continues for the rest of the week: péntek becomes pénteken, szombat becomes szombaton, and vasárnap needs nothing extra.
is here means 'too / also', not 'is' — Szombat vagy vasárnap is jó literally reads 'Saturday or Sunday also good', i.e. 'Saturday or Sunday works too'.
